observations.main: Sky remains smooth, coarse lattice crossings and fine building wires have the same apparent continuity. Foliage remains soft in every arm.
observations.cab: All four views preserve the existing faint diagonals and incomplete crossings, with no apparent false color added at the fixed display exposure.
observations.target: All three half-precision paths look similar on the railway and dahlia. The yellow petals remain too bright.
observations.outliers: The largest FP16 engine delta sits on saturated magenta signage and the FP8 delta on orange LED characters. The printed lettering shapes remain visually similar.
